title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.03097v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. translated_title: DR Pixel：基于视觉语言模型的页面原生深度研究
translated_abstract: 复杂文档（如科学论文）在表格、图表和公式中包含丰富的信息；然而，现有的深度研究（DR）智能体通常将论文简化为OCR提取的文本。我们转而探究视觉语言模型（VLM）能否实现页面原生的深度研究：直接对渲染后的文档页面图像进行检索与推理。我们提出了DR Pixel，这是首个开源的端到端多模态深度研究智能体，它以渲染的页面图像作为唯一的检索单元和推理单元，运行于一个包含106万页的语料库之上。为评估这一设置，我们构建了DRPixelBench，这是一个基于科学论文的基准，需要对文本、图表、表格和公式进行推理。令人惊讶的是，页面原生深度研究无需任何训练即可表现良好，在GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.5-Flash和Qwen3.6-27B等最先进模型上均优于基于OCR的基线方法，同时所需工具调用次数更少。接下来我们转向深度研究的训练。一个关键挑战……
tldr: DR Pixel是首个开源端到端多模态深度研究智能体，直接以渲染的文档页面图像作为唯一检索单元和推理单元，在科学论文基准上无需训练即超越基于OCR的基线方法，且工具调用次数更少。
en_tdlr: DR Pixel is the first open-source end-to-end multimodal deep research agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, outperforming OCR-based baselines on scientific papers without any training while requiring fewer tool calls.
